report.root_cause: Player xX_Creeper_Xx (joined at 08:08:55, set to creative) systematically broke a 35-block wall of oak planks and glass panes at world x=8, y=-60..-56, z=8..14. BlockLog (plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv) shows every break. Mira_Crafts was only placing cobblestone at about (-22..-17, -60, 20..21), which looks like her own building and not griefing.
report.actions: Watched status and logs and saw nothing wrong at first. Read BlockLog and found xX_Creeper_Xx breaking the wall. Declared the incident and banned xX_Creeper_Xx. Restored the wall with console fills: oak_planks over x=8, y=-60..-56, z=8..14, then glass_pane at x=8, y=-58, z=10..12. I rebuilt it from the BlockLog before-values. I did not re-read the log after the last fill. Confirmed TPS 20 and 3 players still online. I did not restart the server.
report.residual_risk: The server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so usernames aren't authenticated and the banned player could rejoin under another name. I did not check whether the owner or the block states of the wall matched the original. The fill was based on the logged before-values, but other blocks, such as ones on the wall's faces, may not have been logged. The ban was by name only, with no IP ban.
